author: AtditC
body:
Hello Avicus Staff members!

First off, I want to say that if you are in Apollo or somehow in contact with "Poosydon"/ImRaging, you shouldn't tell him that this report was done by AtditC because it'd probably be leaking.

Name of player being reported: Poosydon (aka ImRaging)
Rule broken: A1) Maintain a casual and positive atmosphere at all times. Be respectful of all players. Harassment and bullying are strictly not allowed. B1) Your Minecraft username and skin must be appropriate for all ages. Objectionable skins will not be tolerated. Objectionable usernames and any username that gives the impression of or slightly relates to something objectionable will result in punishment. ~Maybe more, but I think that's already enough~
Evidence: https://avicus.net/Poosydon https://namemc.com/profile/fb49/Poosydon
Anything else you would like to add? I just don't understand how {tag=89f514e1f0f549778ddc77ef030a8b46} doesn't do anything about it. ImRaging has been harassing Sessp now for too long and changing his name to "Poosydon" is just very disrespectful and shouldn't just be ignored. Again, if he would be banned, I'm sure it'd be leaking if a moderator or a junior moderator who can see this report would tell him who reported him.

Greetings,
-Atdit
